objective: Bound an external runner's stdout and stderr instead of capturing them with an unbounded PIPE, so a runaway runner cannot exhaust memory before it is killed.
acceptance: runner stdout and stderr are captured to bounded sinks, not to an unbounded PIPE
a runner that exceeds the output budget is stopped and reported as blocked rather than truncated into a pass
the blocked report is typed and bounded, and its detail does not echo unbounded runner output
a runner that exceeds its time budget is still reported as a timeout, unchanged
a normal runner's output is still captured in full and its evidence unchanged
no runner is left running after the budget trips
evidence: build/verify.sh reports no new failures against the 12-failure environmental baseline
stop_conditions: bounding the output would truncate evidence a passing run depends on
an interface schema under interfaces/ would have to change
a subprocess would be left orphaned
